name: Vitality Prime, Inc.
summary: SpectralCast, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of specialized electronic goods. The firm also integrates and advances various consumer electronic offerings with its secure digital infrastructure, the Orbital Organic Network, commonly known as the Overnet. Among its product offerings are 58-inch and 55-inch Orbital Elite LED televisions, alongside a 42-inch multi-functional LCD television. Established as 7 Star Entertainment, Inc., the company adopted the name SpectralCast, Inc. in January 2014. Its operations are headquartered in San Diego, California.
